title: French Berry Crumble
description: A classic French dessert featuring a mixture of juicy berries topped with a crumbly oat mixture and baked to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the berries and granulated sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the rolled oats, brown sugar, and salt to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Pour the berry mixture into a 9x9-inch baking dish and top with the crumb mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
